author: CNN
description:
Thirty House Democrats sent a letter to Secretary of State Marco Rubio urging the Trump administration to acknowledge Israel's nuclear program.

The lawmakers argue that they have a "constitutional responsibility to be fully informed about the nuclear balance in the Middle East," and that they should know "the risk of escalation  by any party in this conflict".

Should the Trump administration inform Congress and the American people of Israel's nuclear capability? A CNN NewsNight panel debates.

0:00 How did Israel get nuclear weapons in the first place?
3:50 Did the US lose leverage over Israel when it gained nuclear weapons?
4:51 Should the US know if Israel intends to strike Iran?

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#Trump #Israel #News
title: Debate: Should Trump reveal Israel's nuclear arsenal?

author: CNN
description:
Passengers have begun to disembark the cruise ship at the center of the hantavirus outbreak, Spain’s ministry of health said, in a carefully managed repatriation operation in Tenerife involving multiple nations. 

Since the vessel departed Argentina last month, the deaths of three people have been linked to hantavirus -– a rare disease typically caused by exposure to infected rats’ urine or feces. 

CNN’s Kim Brunhuber speaks with Dr. Scott Miscovich about the disembarkation operation of the MV Hondius cruise ship. Also, CNN’s Danny Feeman discusses the Nebraska facility where American passengers will be taken with Dr. H. Dele Davies.
